meta.name: xlsx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打开、编辑、创建和转换电子表格文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理 Excel 或 CSV 文件
copy.tagline_en: Open, edit, create, and convert spreadsheet files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with Excel or CSV files

howto.what: 处理电子表格文件时,Claude 会用专门工具打开、创建和修改 .xlsx、.csv 等文件,在单元格内写计算公式而不是直接写结果,并自动重算、检查公式错误,最后给出排版规范、无公式错误的表格文件。
howto.when: 当你要求以电子表格为主要输入或输出时触发,比如打开、读取或修改 .xlsx/.csv 等文件;哪怕是随口提到文件名也会触发。主要产出若是 Word 或 HTML 报告,则不触发。

say.text: 读取下载文件夹里的 sales.xlsx,把 B 列改成销售额计算公式。
say.note: Claude 会打开文件写入公式,并自动重算检查无误。

say.text: 把 data.csv 转成带格式的 xlsx,并加自动筛选。
say.note: Claude 会新建一个规范排版的 Excel 文件。

say.text: 修一下财务模型.xlsx,把 #REF! 错误找出来改好。
say.note: Claude 会先诊断错误,再修改并重算确认。

howto.what_en: Claude handles spreadsheet files with dedicated tools: opens, creates, edits .xlsx/.csv, writes formulas rather than hardcoded values, recalculates and validates them, and delivers formatted error-free sheets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a spreadsheet is the main input/output: open, edit, or fix .xlsx/.csv, create or convert tables, including casual filename mentions. Not when the main deliverable is a Word/HTML report.

say_en.text: Read sales.xlsx in Downloads; set column B to a formula for revenue.
say_en.note: Claude will edit cells and recalculate the file.

say_en.text: Convert data.csv into a formatted xlsx with auto-filter.
say_en.note: Creates a new formatted spreadsheet file.

say_en.text: Find and fix the #REF! errors in financial model.xlsx.
say_en.note: Claude diagnoses, repairs, and recalcs the file.
